verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Omarchy ships nineteen built-in themes, selectable via Style > Theme in the Omarchy Menu. A theme restyles the whole system at once (terminal, bar, notifications, wallpaper), and theme matching extends to editors like VSCode, Cursor, Helix and Zed. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that switching is instant (applied live without a restart or re-login), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the theme switching.
